name: atlas hub
summary: Multi-layer trusted discovery and distribution of process applications and related product catalogues, with independently governed standalone catalogues, reusable components and public, internal or commercial offers. No runtime licensing.
next_action: Review draft PR #1424 for durable pending-only atlas hub provenance; finish verified native application/catalogue completion and restart recovery (#1422), then publish a public independently signed demonstration registry.
